CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
February 8, 2022 –
7:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF FORMER PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSIONER - It is recommended the City Council present an appreciation plaque and tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts to Mark Madison for his years of dedicated service to the community.
5.1 Recognition of Former Commissioner
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of January 25, 2022.
7.1 Minutes of 1-25-22 CC Mtg
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated February 8, 2022 in the total amount of $1,067,843.98.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
LA MIRADA SYMPHONY FUNDING REQUEST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 - It is recommended the City Council approve La Mirada Symphony’s Fiscal Year 2021-22 funding request for direct support in the amount of $2,500 and an in-kind contribution of $35,000 for a total of $37,500.
7.3 La Mirada Symphony Funding Request
7.4
AMENDED AND RESTATED GROUND LEASE AGREEMENT WITH STC ONE LLC - It is recommended the City Council approve the Amended and Restated Ground Lease Agreement between the City of La Mirada and STC ONE LLC and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.4 Ground Lease Agreement
7.5
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING NOVEMBER 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending November 2021.
7.5 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.6
CITY OF LA MIRADA FINANCIAL TRANSACTIONS REPORT FISCAL YEAR 2020-21 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Financial Transactions Report for Fiscal Year 2020-21.
7.6 Financial Transactions Report
7.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-09, SPLASH! PUMP ROOM CONTROLS UPGRADE PROJECT PHASE II – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT – It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-09, Splash! Pump Room Controls Upgrade Project Phase II, to California Commercial Pools, Inc. in the amount of $198,700; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total construction cost.
7.7 CIP No. 2021-09
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 22-04 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR THE SHUTTERED VENUE OPERATORS GRANT AND AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN FUNDS OF 2021- It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-04 authorizing a budget amendment for the Shuttered Venue Operators Grant and American Rescue Plan Funds of 2021.
8.1 Resolution No. 22-04
